name: china-storage-2035
question: By 2035, China's energy-storage & battery market: structured forecast of market size, segments, drivers, risks, and CR5/CR10 concentration / winners & losers.

expected_outcome.scenario: Continued capacity growth with price-war shakeout; concentration rises; winners are integrated cell+system players with overseas channels
key_signals: market size in GWh and value with CAGR
expected_outcome.rationale: Reward quantitative grounding (GWh, CAGR, CR-N), segment coverage, and explicit risk/uncertainty handling.
